title: Existence of Dynamical Low-Rank Approximation for SDEs with Locally Lipschitz Coefficients
summary: In this work, we consider the Dynamical Low Rank Approximation (DLRA) of a high-dimensional system of Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs); DLRA is an effective reduced order model that projects the equations on a time-varying low dimensional subspace following the evolution of the solution. Well posedness results for the resulting DLRA equations have been proved in arXiv:2308.11581 under the assumption of global Lipschitz continuity and linear growth of the drift and the diffusion coefficients.
